name: Pocket Touch
subtitle: Legacy iOS emulation in your pocket.
description: Pocket Touch is an unofficial port of Light Touch for Mac, under its license. It isn’t made or endorsed by Light Touch’s developer.

apps.name: Pocket Touch
apps.subtitle: Run iPhone OS 1 to iOS 3 on your iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription:
Emulates the original iPod touch, iPhone and iPad. Comes with an iPod touch (2nd generation) on iOS 3.1.3 ready to go.

For full speed, turn on JIT: in AltStore, go to My Apps, press and hold Pocket Touch, and tap Enable JIT. Without it, Pocket Touch runs in slow mode.

An unofficial port of Light Touch for Mac.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Attach to Local Network lets the emulated device reach computers and printers on your network.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: The Carrier panel can place the emulated iPhone’s GPS where you are.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Tilt with iPhone moves the emulated device’s accelerometer as you tilt your iPhone.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Screenshots and screen recordings of the emulated device are saved to your photo library.
